description:
A desktop gateway that connects AI tools to API providers, subscriptions, and local models.

CONST API provides OpenAI Responses / Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages, and Gemini API interfaces behind one local endpoint. Add API keys, supported subscriptions, or OpenAI-compatible local servers as model channels, connect tools such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode, and inspect channel health, model availability, usage, and errors. Local use needs no account; the hosted Model Marketplace requires a CONST account.
CONST API desktop client release.
The macOS app and DMG are signed with Apple Developer ID, notarized by Apple,
and carry stapled notarization tickets. Windows does not yet include
Authenticode signing. Linux AppImage has no platform package signature.
This release does not include a server container image.
